name: Eden II
source:
Following the previous work "EDEN" a rescue team was dispatched to the moon base.

The rescue team included the following people: Captain Greg Cicero, Flare Shaffer, Karin Shaffer, Hannah Wiese, and Nazi Ashtray.

Wandering around the underground labyrinth of the moon's ruins...

Will they become new prey?
Can you escape from the alien's hunt?
Who will survive?

[Translated and edited from [url=http://www.will-game.com/forester/pro/eden2/eden2.htm]Will-Game[/url]]
translation:
继前作《EDEN》之后，一支救援队被派往月球基地。

救援队成员包括格雷格·西塞罗队长、芙蕾雅·谢弗、卡琳·谢弗、汉娜·维泽，以及纳齐·阿什特雷。

他们在月球遗迹的地下迷宫中不断徘徊…

会成为新的猎物吗？
能够逃脱外星生物的狩猎吗？
谁能活到最后？

[翻译并编辑自[url=http://www.will-game.com/forester/pro/eden2/eden2.htm]Will-Game[/url]]
